problem: Let $A$ be a $3\times 3$ matrix with the characteristic polynomial $p(\lambda )=-{\lambda }^{3}+2{\lambda }^{2}+22.$ Then, ${A}^{3}=$
worked_solution:
Using the Cayley-Hamilton theorem, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}p(A) & =O \\ -{A}^{3}+2{A}^{2}+22I & =O \\ {A}^{3} & =2{A}^{2}+22I.\end{aligned}
$$
